subject: [PATCH 4/7] SUNRPC: bound the local rpcbind client timeout to 1s

2026-08-10.patch_summary: This patch limits the timeout for the local rpcbind client to 1 second. The previous default timeouts of 10 seconds for AF_LOCAL and 60 seconds for loopback TCP fallback were causing stalls in NFS server operations, leading to hung-task watchdog warnings. By reducing the timeout, the patch shortens the stall time but does not completely eliminate it. The real fix would be to make the registration asynchronous, which is a more complex task.
